# 1_70

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted">not adopted</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted" title="Locked flights are released from the window; trained and scored in that environment">release MDP</span>

**What changed:** No ±30 s bracket, seed 2: 1_61's recipe (TMB, difficulty curriculum from scratch, v2 with the MONAD mask, mask-frame fix) without the ±30 s landing bracket, so the top bracket is ±60 s, the success definition.

!!! note "Release MDP"
    This model trained in the release MDP, unlike the champion and every model before `1_49`: after each step the front of the landing queue is released once a flight is locked (predicted within 30 s of its target and in no predicted conflict). A released flight leaves the window and can no longer be cleared. It is scored in the same environment, on the same seeds and with the same metrics, so its numbers measure landings in the same scenarios, but under that extra constraint on the agent.

!!! info "About this run"
    Two seeds (1_68, 1_70) against the three seeds of the baseline (1_61, 1_63, 1_65): within the seed-to-seed spread, so the bracket stayed.
